sloka: भर्तृमक्तिं पुरस्कृत्य रामादन्यस्य वानर ।न स्पृशामि शरीरं तु पुंसो वाररपुङ्गवः ।। ५.३७.६०।।।।
transliteration: bhartṛmaktiṁ puraskṛtya rāmādanyasya vānara ।na spṛśāmi śarīraṁ tu puṁso vārarapuṅgavaḥ ।। 5.37.60।।।।

translations.english: "Both Rama and Lakshmana who are emaciated with sorrow and suffering on account of me will give up their lives along with vanaras and bears.
